name: bun-infisical
description: Bun runtime with Infisical CLI pre-installed
author: S Saha (atssj)

scripts.lint: hadolint -c hadolint.yaml Dockerfile && shellcheck *.sh tests/*.sh && oxlint
scripts.lint:local: docker build -f Dockerfile.lint -t bun-infisical-lint . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" bun-infisical-lint sh -c 'bun install && bun run lint && oxfmt --check'
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run format:check
